_about: Traceability for every AWS-derived shape used by this lab. It separates AWS-DOCUMENTED STRUCTURE (field names, nesting, output key template, response shape) from COURSE-AUTHORED VALUES (the specific strings and numbers in the scenarios). Every value in scenarios/ is invented for this exercise. None is an observed AWS result.

result_record.s3_key.source: Amazon Bedrock User Guide - Understand how the results of your model evaluation job are saved in Amazon S3

result_record.records[].source: Amazon Bedrock User Guide - same page, worked example

job_summary.source: Amazon Bedrock API Reference - ListEvaluationJobs / EvaluationSummary
job_summary.note: EvaluationSummary does not carry the prompt dataset, the metric names, or the inference parameters.

job_definition.note: GetEvaluationJob returns evaluationConfig and inferenceConfig in full.

inferenceConfig.models.verbatim: For automated model evaluation jobs, only a single model is supported. For human-based model evaluation jobs, your annotator can compare the responses for up to two different models. Array Members: Minimum number of 1 item. Maximum number of 2 items.
inferenceConfig.models.note: Every scenario in this lab uses automated jobs, so every models array holds exactly one model.

evaluationConfig.automated.datasetMetric.source: Amazon Bedrock User Guide - Starting an automatic model evaluation job (CLI/SDK examples)

bedrockModel.inferenceParams.source: Amazon Bedrock User Guide - Starting an automatic model evaluation job (SDK for Python example)
bedrockModel.inferenceParams.note: Exposed only by the full job definition. Not present in the result record and not present in EvaluationSummary. This is the fact scenario_03 rests on.

course_authored_values._note: Invented for this exercise. Not observed AWS output. Realistic in shape only.
course_authored_values.job_uuids: invented 12-character hex-like strings, matching the documented ARN pattern shape
course_authored_values.prompts_and_responses: invented; the prompt/referenceResponse pairs follow the shape of AWS's documented custom-dataset example
course_authored_values.account_id: 111122223333 - AWS's own documentation placeholder account ID
course_authored_values.bucket: amzn-s3-demo-bucket - AWS's own documentation placeholder bucket name

model_and_dataset_identifiers._note: Model identifiers and built-in dataset names are documented by AWS. They are used here as realistic values. This lab makes no claim about the behaviour, quality or suitability of any named model.

what_this_lab_does_not_encode: any list of fields that must match for two evaluation results to be comparable
any materiality label for any difference in any scenario
